name: Stellant Securities (India) Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1991, Stellant Securities 
(India) Ltd is in the business of providing consultancy services[1]
keyPoints:
Change of Objects Clause:[1]
In FY25, the company amended its Memorandum of Association to include NBFC operations, enabling it to provide loans, leasing, hire-purchase, and financing for various assets, along with issuing guarantees. It also added investment & holding activities, allowing the company to buy, sell, trade, and manage securities, acquire stakes, and manage surplus funds. Additionally, it introduced advisory services focused on corporate finance and commercial matters.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 38.4% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 58.3%
Promoter holding has increased by 3.02% over last quarter.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Working capital days have increased from 24.3 days to 71.8 days
